content: If you miss a dose of this medication, it is essential to contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to obtain a new dosing schedule. For proper storage of this medication, refer to the product instructions and consult your pharmacist for specific details. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, ensure it is discarded properly. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. While using this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., kidney function tests) may be required to monitor your condition and ensure the medication's safety and efficacy. It is crucial to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, do not attempt to double up or self-adjust your schedule. Instead, promptly consult your doctor or pharmacist for guidance on how to proceed. For storage, follow the product's specific instructions and consult your pharmacist if you have any questions. Avoid improper disposal methods such as flushing or draining unless explicitly directed. When the medication is no longer needed or has expired, dispose of it responsibly.
